data.title: How Will Bitcoin, Ethereum and XRP React if CLARITY Act Passes or Fails?
data.description: The CLARITY Act has become a major regulatory focus for the crypto industry. However, Alex Tapscott, CEO of CMCC Global Capital Markets, said prediction markets may be overstating its chances of passing. While markets currently assign the bill roughly 47% to 50% odds of becoming law, Tapscott said…
